title: 1_2_Dog_Days

quiz.question: What does the word 'abhor' mean?
options: To fall asleep because something is super boring.

quiz.question: What does the word 'elicit' mean?
options: A beast with an elephant head on a smaller elephant's body.

quiz.question: If an object travels at 3 feet per second, how many feet does it travel in one hour?
quiz.question_short: 3 feet per second. How many feet in an hour?
options: Trick question! Objects don't have 3 feet! Burned!

quiz.question: Which of the following is a factor of the sum of 15 + 45?
quiz.question_short: A factor of the sum of 15 + 45?

quiz.question: Which of the following is NOT a multiple of the sum of 9 + 3?
quiz.question_short: NOT a multiple of the sum of 9 + 3?
options: Me! I am not a multiple of 9 + 3!

quiz.question: If n + 1 = 25, what is the value of 3n + 3?
A number is divided by 4. The result is divided by 4, which equals 2. What was the original number?
quiz.question_short: Number divided by 4. Result divided by 4 to get 2. Original number?
options: I'm too smart to answer such easy questions.

quiz.question: What does the word 'fathom' mean?
options: To get a question wrong in a quiz.

quiz.question: What does the word 'gratuitous' mean?
options: Spitting everywhere like a camel. In short, not cool.

quiz.question: What does the word 'hackneyed' mean?
options: We couldn't think of anything for this... Wink. Wink.

quiz.question: What does the word 'iconoclast' mean?
options: One who can transform into a robot.
One who is really good with a computer.

question_options.question: How would you rate this episode?
Which Troublemaker do you want to hear more about?
Do you want Paige and Owen to get back together?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'm happy to help!
Just then, Kimi comes running up to $ALLISON and Owen with a worried look on her face, her tiny dog bounding excitedly along with her.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Guys! We need help!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Paige's dog got loose! It totally just spun around and snapped at Paige's hand, and she let go of the leash!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh no!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Is Paige okay?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: She's fine, but she's `super` stressed out!
nodes.text_bbcode: She's fine, but she's [color=#3b78e2][i]super[/i][/color] stressed out!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I don't blame her. The shelter supervisor made it very clear that we're on thin ice.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We've gotta find it!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'll help!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Erik, stay here and watch the dogs!
Erik gives a salute, splashing suds all over his forehead.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Right!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You simply couldn't help it.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What, like I'm some sort of mindless punching machine?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: No! I didn't mean you are violent by nature!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I simply meant to imply that you were provoked. Naturally, you reacted with anger, but that is not who you are.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You are `not` a mindless punching machine. No more than I am a mindless judo-flipping machine. Our actions were simply misunderstood.
nodes.text_bbcode: You are [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] a mindless punching machine. No more than I am a mindless judo-flipping machine. Our actions were simply misunderstood.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: 'Misunderstood'... Yeah. I think I like that phrasing better.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Thanks for giving me the benefit of the doubt. It's more than I get from `some` people. Means a lot, $ALLISON.
nodes.text_bbcode: Thanks for giving me the benefit of the doubt. It's more than I get from [color=#e23b3b][i]some[/i][/color] people. Means a lot, $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Someone provoked an emotional response from you. While possibly excessive, it's not wholly reflective of your character.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: ...Meaning?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Meaning it doesn't make you 'dangerous' or a 'bad person'.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: In fact, I believe you had good intentions. You're just misunderstood.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Wow... Well, thanks for giving me the benefit of the doubt. It's more than I get from `some` people. Means a lot, $ALLISON.
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow... Well, thanks for giving me the benefit of the doubt. It's more than I get from [color=#e23b3b][i]some[/i][/color] people. Means a lot, $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Well, you can't afford to get heated... Especially not with your history.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: My... History? You mean... The football accident?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Not that... I've been digging into your record, and it says here that back at your last school, you ran with a pretty bad crowd. The 12th Street Kids, was it?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Combined with your latest fiasco, this could ruin all the hard work you've been putting in lately. If I'm going by the book, this calls for a major suspension...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Please, Ms. Lee... I can't be suspended! I'd fall behind on my classes! I'd be kicked off the football team!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I assure you it wouldn't be the end of the world.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It would be for me! I need to get into a good school so I can get a good job! And I need a good job so I can get money!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Because if I stay poor, I'll never prove myself to...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: To... Never mind.
Ms. Lee thinks to herself and sighs.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: There is one alternative. There's a new program for troublemakers like you. You wouldn't be suspended, but you'll have to do some work...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Whatever it is, I'll do it.
You are now playing as $ALLISON...
Present day...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That's such a sad story...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: The suspense is killing me! Did you join the Troublemakers program?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Erik, why would I even be here today if I didn't--

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Wait! Don't tell me! I don't want spoilers.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: So... This whole thing was about Paige?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What? No!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I mean... I suppose it may have been somewhat related to her, but don't tell her that.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Of course. But, for what it's worth, I think that what you did was...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I couldn't stand idly by and let him get away with it. The way he was talking was just... Wrong!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Well, I suppose I have to give you credit for your moral conviction and punching technique.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: ...But how exactly does a right cross change that boy's mind? Couldn't you have just used words?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I... I guess I just got heated.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: You jeopardized your future for a girlfriend?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, no. She's not actually my girlfriend anymore... But still, that guy was saying some really shady stuff about her...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: And punching him did what exactly? Restore her honor?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well... No. I guess I just got heated.
`WHACK!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]WHACK![/b]

nodes.text: Later, Ms. Lee paces through her office, flipping through a file folder as Owen slumps in a chair, arms crossed.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: This is not good. Not good at all. You knocked that boy out cold!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: The principal has tasked me with taking disciplinary action with you. I've been looking through your record...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: It's seems like you've been turning over a new leaf this summer. Signing up for extra-curriculars, enrolling in summer school courses, all while continuing football!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I've seen students break down from this kind of workload. But you've been handling it excellently.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Um... Thanks?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Don't thank me yet. That said, how could you do this? Don't you know how a fight can damage your record? And did you at least shift your hips properly when you punched? Sloppy form leads to injuries!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I was only--

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Wait, what about my form?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Never mind that. Tell me why you hit that boy!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I hit him because of...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You can only see in black and white?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No, Erik. No.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What I mean is that people have called me dangerous without knowing my story either.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I would very much like to hear your story.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You... You would?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Huzzah! Storytime!
Owen sighs as the three of them lift their dogs into tubs of soapy water.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, all right... A lot of people know about how I injured someone during a football game...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But not a lot of people know why it was such a big deal.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Back in my hometown, I ran with a pretty rough crowd.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Me and all the kids who lived south of 12th Street were known for getting into trouble. We were pretty rowdy I guess. Mostly we pulled harmless pranks.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But the pranks got worse. Graffiti, smashing mailboxes... We started heading down a bad path.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Soon, my friends had a reputation for causing havoc. 'Look out for those 12th Street Kids'. 'Those 12th Street kids are nothing but trouble'.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That wasn't me. I knew I had to get out... I was about to tell them that I was done with all that.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But before I could, things got a `lot` worse.
nodes.text_bbcode: But before I could, things got a [color=#e23b3b][i]lot[/i][/color] worse.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You mean, the boy you tackled on the football field?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah. There was so much pressure that night. My dad... My `coach` told me to win at any cost.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah. There was so much pressure that night. My dad... My [color=#e23b3b][i]coach[/i][/color] told me to win at any cost.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I made a mistake. I hurt that guy, bad. And I realized I was no better than the other 12th Street Kids. Maybe worse.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I couldn't live with it. I had to leave, make a new start.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So I came to Twin Branches, and it's been a lot of fun... I've met some great people...
Owen's gaze drifts, just for a second, out the window and across the field, to where Paige walks her poodle with the others...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: ...But recently, my past caught up with me.
$ALLISON notices Owen's hands... Through the water and soap, she glimpses the bruises on his knuckles.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Owen... Perhaps it's not my place to ask, but... Your hand? Was there another physical altercation?
Owen sighs. He glances across the field again, making sure Paige and the others have left.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I guess I might as well tell someone. As long as you guys keep this quiet.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Of course!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I promise!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: All right, well... It was a couple weeks ago...
You are now playing as Owen.
Weeks earlier...
Owen walks down the hall after an especially grueling summer school calculus course.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Ugh... I don't know how much more of this I can take...
As he trudges toward his locker, a group of nerds rushes past him, triumphantly holding an orange safety cone in the air.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Onward! For the Wirewolves, and for glory!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: ...What exactly are they `doing` in Medieval History class?
nodes.text_bbcode: ...What exactly are they [color=#e23b3b][i]doing[/i][/color] in Medieval History class?

nodes.text: His thoughts are interrupted by the sound of devious snickering from the corner of the hallway.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Did you hear about Paige and Owen?
Owen's ears prick up at the mention of his name. He listens discreetly...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Yeah, Paige went all rebellious and angry-at-the-world... It's pretty hot!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: But that's not even the best part. Chicks like that? When they're an emotional mess, they're just desperate for a rebound!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: She'll probably make out with anyone! Guess I know what `I'll` be doing Friday night.
nodes.text_bbcode: She'll probably make out with anyone! Guess I know what [color=#e23b3b][i]I'll[/i][/color] be doing Friday night.

nodes.text: The boys chuckle to themselves. Unable to contain himself, Owen storms over to them.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey! I heard what you said.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So you're going to `stop.` And you're not going anywhere `near` Paige.
nodes.text_bbcode: So you're going to [color=#e23b3b][i]stop.[/i][/color] And you're not going anywhere [color=#e23b3b][i]near[/i][/color] Paige.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: What do `you` care? You're not even her boyfriend anymore!
nodes.text_bbcode: What do [color=#e23b3b][i]you[/i][/color] care? You're not even her boyfriend anymore!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Never mind that. Just know that that's the `last` time you're ever going to talk about Paige like that.
nodes.text_bbcode: Never mind that. Just know that that's the [color=#e23b3b][i]last[/i][/color] time you're ever going to talk about Paige like that.

nodes.text: Zach steps up to Owen, firing a defiant glare straight into his eyes. Owen returns the stare right back, his fist clenched tightly with rage...

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: I'll talk however I want to talk. And if Paige needs my shoulder to cry on, well, it's all hers.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: And maybe more...
Owen's rage is blinding!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's it!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: A creature with a history of violence must be treated accordingly, so that it doesn't hurt anyone else...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, maybe there's `more` to the story that you don't know!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, maybe there's [color=#e23b3b][i]more[/i][/color] to the story that you don't know!

nodes.speaker: Dog
nodes.text: Huff huff huff...
Owen turns back to his task, his brow furrowed.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I've... I've said something offensive, haven't I?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No... No, it's not your fault. It's just that... This dog kinda reminds me of `me`.
nodes.text_bbcode: No... No, it's not your fault. It's just that... This dog kinda reminds me of [color=#e23b3b][i]me[/i][/color].

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: If this dog was misunderstood at his previous home, perhaps this is a good opportunity for him to find a new one.
Owen's expression softens, and he nods thoughtfully.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah... Maybe you're right.

nodes.speaker: Dog
nodes.text: Huff huff huff...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sorry I snapped. It's just this dog kinda reminds me of `me`.
nodes.text_bbcode: Sorry I snapped. It's just this dog kinda reminds me of [color=#e23b3b][i]me[/i][/color].

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I, for one, kept it simple. I choose the dog whose bark sounded the most like `'Erik! Erik'!` Clearly it was trying to get my attention.
nodes.text_bbcode: I, for one, kept it simple. I choose the dog whose bark sounded the most like [color=#e23b3b][i]'Erik! Erik'![/i][/color] Clearly it was trying to get my attention.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Owen, which dog are you choosing?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh, I made my decision pretty early on.
Owen walks over to the cages and soon returns with a weathered, patchy-haired bulldog. A scar lines its face, and one of its droopy ears looks torn and long-since healed.

nodes.speaker: Dog
nodes.text: `Hrruf!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Hrruf![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: They say this one bit his owner's hand once and was considered dangerous. He was dropped off at the shelter not long after.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Perhaps the decision was for the best.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's 'for the best' that this dog was just cast aside?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I only thought it beneficial because...

options.label: This dog may find a new home.

nodes.text: $ALLISON picks up the terrier and cradles it.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: This one! She's naturally inquisitive... See how she investigated her surroundings? The hallmark of a true scholar!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Good choice. I think her personality matches yours, even if her looks don't.
The terrier snuggles in $ALLISON's arms and even gives her a lick on the cheek.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Appearances aren't everything.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: This one is of a handsome stock! Her hair is a healthy red, like mine! ...A show-worthy specimen!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And this is the one you identify with?
Owen waves his hand in front of the retriever. She stares dimly, ignoring him.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: She doesn't seem to match your personality though. You're really bright, and this dog... Um... Is not.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Well, I suppose you're right... I simply was drawn to her because she looks like me.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I get it. But looks aren't everything, you know. Sometimes there's more than what you see on the surface.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: T... True...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Right, totally 'lame'... Of course...
Embarrassed, $ALLISON realizes that she is still standing and takes an empty seat next to Erik.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Huzzah! $ALLISON has arrived!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Well, at least one person is excited for our continued association.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Erik sounds excited for everything.
$ALLISON looks over to Erik, whose eyes light up at the school supplies on his desk.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Huzzah! Erasers!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That puts things in perspective.
Just then, Ms. Lee walks into the room with a no-nonsense stride.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: All right, Troublemakers. Ready to redeem your past trouble-makings with more mandatory labor?
The group groans.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I know the alternative to this is way worse and stuff, but you make it sound like we're pack animals, Ms. Lee.
A devious smile spreads across Ms. Lee's face.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: It's funny you should mention animals, Ms. Chen... Because you're all going to be volunteering at the Centerscore Animal Shelter!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You mean our community service is gonna be working with some flea-ridden strays?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah! Are there at least some cute, flea-ridden `puppies?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah! Are there at least some cute, flea-ridden [color=#3b78e2][i]puppies?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I think perhaps you are both missing the point...
Later, $ALLISON and the Troublemakers gather outside of the Centerscore Animal Shelter, where an impatient man shouts orders at them.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Oates
nodes.text: All right, listen up! I don't want to be here, and you don't want to be here.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I want to be here!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Oates
nodes.text: Still! I told the school board that our shelter needed volunteers, and they responded by sending me their hopeless delinquents.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Oates
nodes.text: Out of the goodness of my heart, I have decided to trust these poor creatures into your hands.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Oates
nodes.text: You're going to split into two groups. Three of you will be walking dogs, and the other three will be washing them.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I call dog washing team! It's the closest I'll get to washing a small, furry version of myself!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: That's... Ew.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Washing stuff? That's like a chore! We're going for the walking team, right Owen?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You go ahead, man. I don't think I have the energy to walk right now.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Guess the decision's made for me. I am `not` working on the same team as Owen.
nodes.text_bbcode: Guess the decision's made for me. I am [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] working on the same team as Owen.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Likewise.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: We're walking, Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: We are? ...I mean, we are!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I suppose that puts me on washing duty as well.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Oates
nodes.text: Well, this is all very interesting, but I need to see to my other duties. You can choose from the dogs in the kennel out back.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Oates
nodes.text: But know that I did `count` them earlier, and I `will` know if one is missing.
nodes.text_bbcode: But know that I did [color=#e23b3b][i]count[/i][/color] them earlier, and I [color=#e23b3b][i]will[/i][/color] know if one is missing.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: We're not going to steal your dogs, weirdo.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Oates
nodes.text: Be that as it may, I've got my eye on all of you. `One` slip-up, and I'm reporting you to Ms. Lee! She'll have you suspended so fast your head will spin!
nodes.text_bbcode: Be that as it may, I've got my eye on all of you. [color=#e23b3b][i]One[/i][/color] slip-up, and I'm reporting you to Ms. Lee! She'll have you suspended so fast your head will spin!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Gulp!
Before leaving, the supervisor shows the students to a row of pens. Inside, various dogs yap for attention, pacing in their enclosed spaces.
Soon after...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I love my dog! She's just like those pocket-sized ones that celebutantes have! She's so fashionable!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I wanna carry her in a purse! Or like, a little picnic basket! That would be soooooo cute!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You realize you're going to have to actually `walk` your dog, right?
nodes.text_bbcode: You realize you're going to have to actually [color=#3b78e2][i]walk[/i][/color] your dog, right?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: She can walk in place inside the basket!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ohmigosh, that would be even cuter!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ugh. I'll pass on 'trendy' little dogs. I chose something classy and refined.
At the end of Paige's leash is a well-groomed poodle, sitting confidently at her side with her nose turned up.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Your dogs seem to fit your personalities...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: But Spencer, I had imagined you would choose a dog that was more... Imposing?
Spencer runs out of the pen with a tiny beagle at his heels!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That shelter guy said that this dog never runs out of energy. Said that I would get tired before this little guy.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `...Challenge accepted!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]...Challenge accepted![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Spencer runs in circles, zigging and zagging as the dog bounds energetically to keep up. Paige and Kimi soon follow, leading their dogs down the path into a nearby park.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hmm. Maybe Spencer `did` find the dog version of himself. What about you, $ALLISON? Which dog do you think is the most like you?
nodes.text_bbcode: Hmm. Maybe Spencer [color=#e23b3b][i]did[/i][/color] find the dog version of himself. What about you, $ALLISON? Which dog do you think is the most like you?

nodes.text: $ALLISON looks at two of the remaining dogs in the pens. One is a small, fidgety terrier with messy, brown hair. She roots around her pen, curiously sniffing and nipping at her bowl, the cage door, and everything within reach.
The other is a pretty, purebred retriever pup with a shiny, reddish coat. She stares blankly into the distance, her tongue lolling out.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Hmm... I think I'll start with...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Slow down, Judo. We're not BFF's just yet.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Plus, if you hadn't taken the hint, I'm not thrilled to be in the same time zone as Owen.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Oh... I just thought...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Look, I get it. We all know that this community service thing is lame, and you're trying to lighten the mood or whatever. But you don't have to try so hard.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: As unfortunate as it is, at least we have the advantage of numbers. Things would be much more difficult had we been alone.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, yeah. I guess there's that.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Still, this community service thing is pretty lame. Anyone who actually enjoys it should get their head checked.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well? ...We're `what?`

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: We're... Troublemakers?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Is that supposed to be inspiring? Look, I get that you're going for the team spirit thing, but you can stop pretending this whole thing isn't totally lame.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Right. Catch ya later, $ALLISON.
Veronica hugs Cameron's arm excessively tight as she leads him away, making sure to sneak one more angry look at $ALLISON before she leaves.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Ugh... Looks like my torrid rivalry with Veronica has not reached its end.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: But on the bright side, I will end this day with my five friends!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Or at least... My five prospective friends?
The rest of the school day flies by as $ALLISON beams in anticipation of her community service time.
As the last bell of the day sounds the end of classes, she practically skips down the halls.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Today has already been better than yesterday! I can't wait to see the rest of the gang!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: And I can't wait to call them 'the rest of the gang'! Just like friends on television!
$ALLISON reports to the appointed classroom to meet with the rest of the Troublemakers.
She walks in to find Paige and Kimi already seated with Erik behind them.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Good afternoon, friends!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh, hey $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Ready for a day of service, fun, and camaraderie?
Paige shoots an incredulous glare at $ALLISON and then at Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Are you serious? Is she serious?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: She can't be. There are `so` many things I'd rather be doing right now. I'm sure it was sarcastic, right $ALLISON?
nodes.text_bbcode: She can't be. There are [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] many things I'd rather be doing right now. I'm sure it was sarcastic, right $ALLISON?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Well, actually I--

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `Booyah!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Booyah![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The group looks back to see Spencer fling the door open as he enters the classroom.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm ready to `crush` this community service! You with me, Owen?
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm ready to [color=#e23b3b][i]crush[/i][/color] this community service! You with me, Owen?

nodes.text: Spencer looks behind him...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: ...Owen?
Owen trails in moments later, dragging his feet. He holds a coffee in his hand and shows bags under his eyes.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Huh? Sure. Let's do this.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Not much of a game face, bro. I'm trying to make an entrance.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sorry, man. I was up studying pretty late last night.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Boo hoo. The world doesn't revolve around you just 'cause you're Mr. Study now.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And you don't get to give everyone extra attitude just because you've decided you're a rebel now.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ooookay. Well, `this` is not awkward at all.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ooookay. Well, [color=#3b78e2][i]this[/i][/color] is not awkward at all.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, let's just get you back to your corner, champ.
Spencer leads Owen to a seat far away from Paige and sits him down. Meanwhile, $ALLISON joins Kimi in trying to pacify Paige.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Can you `believe` him?
nodes.text_bbcode: Can you [color=#3b78e2][i]believe[/i][/color] him?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: He's not thinking straight.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ugh.... Not only am I in trouble, not only do I have to do lame, annoying, boring community service, but my idiot ex-boyfriend is in here with me! This situation is `the worst!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Ugh.... Not only am I in trouble, not only do I have to do lame, annoying, boring community service, but my idiot ex-boyfriend is in here with me! This situation is [color=#3b78e2][i]the worst![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Well, perhaps we should approach this optimistically?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Really? You're giving me 'look-on-the-bright-side'?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: All right, then. Enlighten me. What's the upside here?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: At least we're all...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: ...We confronted a bully!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: ...A bully?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That's right. Some petty, antagonistic, cretin who--
Suddenly, a shrill call sounds from the far end of the parking lot...

nodes.speaker: Veronica
nodes.text: Hey! Cam!
Veronica saunters up and gives Cameron a kiss on the cheek before turning a sideways glare toward $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Hey, Veronica. $ALLISON here was just telling me she confronted a bully yesterday.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Eep!

nodes.speaker: Veronica
nodes.text: Oh, `did` she? And did she tell you the name of this so-called 'bully', who might now be out for revenge?
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, [color=#3b78e2][i]did[/i][/color] she? And did she tell you the name of this so-called 'bully', who might now be out for revenge?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Well... His or her name is not crucial to the narrative... Really it's a story of personal growth...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Yeah, and I'm sure $ALLISON can handle herself.

nodes.speaker: Veronica
nodes.text: I certainly hope so. For her sake.

nodes.speaker: Veronica
nodes.text: Anyway, we've gotta get going. You don't wanna be late for swim practice, right babe?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Perhaps it's socially inappropriate to speak ill of Veronica in Cameron's presence... I will hold my tongue.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: We, uh... cleaned up litter!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: You... Just picked up garbage?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Well, we didn't just pick it up. We subsequently placed it in the proper receptacles.
Suddenly, a shrill call sounds from the far end of the parking lot...

nodes.speaker: Veronica
nodes.text: Hey! Cam!
Veronica saunters up and squeezes Cameron's arm before turning a sideways glare toward $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Hey, Veronica. $ALLISON here was just telling me about how she did a trash clean-up for community service.
Veronica shoots $ALLISON a dagger-like glare.

nodes.speaker: Veronica
nodes.text: Oh, really? And is that `all` she was telling you?
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, really? And is that [color=#3b78e2][i]all[/i][/color] she was telling you?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Well... Um...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Actually, no. They also put the trash in the proper receptacles, heh.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Hee hee...

nodes.speaker: Veronica
nodes.text: Yeah. That's cute. But we've gotta get going. Don't wanna be late for swim practice, right babe?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Actually, yes! I did enjoy the Troublem-- I mean, community service!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Very much!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: And what exactly did you do for 'community service'?
Allison thinks back to yesterday's litter clean-up project, when Veronica, the girl Cameron's been dating, spilled her trash bin...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Well, yesterday something interesting happened...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Not knowing anybody, navigating new class structures, decoding social cues...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: ...It was all very disheartening and emotionally taxing.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Sorry to hear that.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: My first day, I tripped in the cafeteria in front of everybody.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: ...Really?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: No lie. Ketchup everywhere. It was humiliating. But I got through it. It's pretty funny now, actually.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: And it looks like you got through your rough first day too! That's not easy.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I... I appreciate the words of encouragement.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: No problem. But really, did anything good happen?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Just... 'Whatever'?
$ALLISON shifts her stance, leaning against a nearby trash can, trying to look indifferent.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Yeah. You know... `'Whatevs'...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah. You know... [color=#3b78e2][i]'Whatevs'...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: She forms a letter 'W' with her thumbs and forefingers, hoping the gesture is still culturally relevant.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Umm... Okay...
An awkward silence follows...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Yeesh... Perhaps I played that wrong.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Well... Did anything good happen?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: There, there... You're all right, girl. No one's going to hurt you...
$ALLISON crouches low and speaks in a smooth, soothing tone of voice...
Eventually, the poodle relaxes her posture, stops her growling, and sits calmly on her haunches with her tail wagging slightly.
Owen approaches and pets her behind the ears as $ALLISON takes hold of her leash.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It worked!

nodes.prompt: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

nodes.text: $ALLISON tries to stay calm, but a sudden snap of the dogs jaws makes her shriek in reaction!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: `Aaah!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Aaah![/i][/color]

nodes.text: $ALLISON's scream seems to agitate the poodle, but Owen quickly steps in! He offers his lowered hand and speaks smooth, gentle tones...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey, it's okay... No one's going to hurt you, girl...
Eventually, the poodle relaxes her posture, stops her growling, and sits calmly on her haunches with her tail wagging slightly.
Owen approaches and pets her behind the ears as he takes hold of her leash.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Good girl!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You did it, Owen!
...And manages to block its path!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You're not going anywhere!
The poodle turns and bolts in the other direction, but Owen emerges from the trees and stops her escape!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Nowhere to go now! We got you trapped!
Owen and $ALLISON close in on the poodle, inching closer and closer...
Suddenly, the poodle's fur bristles! She growls and barks sharply, snapping her jaws at her two would-be captors!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Whoa! She's freaking out! She'll never let us get close!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: We've merely triggered her fight-or-flight response! She's just trying to defend herself! ...We need to calm her down and convince her that we're not a threat!
$ALLISON moves closer, ever so slowly, and...
Suddenly, the path opens up to a clearing at the edge of the park! The poodle is within sight!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Almost!
$ALLISON sprints toward the dog...
$ALLISON hops over the wood, clearing it without skipping a beat!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Ha!
$ALLISON dives under the wood...
...But the space is too tight!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: `Mmf!` I'm stuck! Just like that bear from that children's cartoon I read about!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Mmf![/i][/color] I'm stuck! Just like that bear from that children's cartoon I read about!

nodes.text: She pulls and paws at the soil... And slowly digs through to the other side!
$ALLISON hesitates...
...And runs straight into the log, tripping over it!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Ow!
She nurses her bruised shin and wounded pride before continuing after the fleeing poodle!
Rounding a corner, $ALLISON spots Paige's white-haired poodle!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: There you are!
She rushes toward the dog... But it bolts away, dashing under a log!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: You won't get away that easily!
$ALLISON rushes toward the fallen log and...
$ALLISON leaps clear over the beagle...
...And crashes headlong into Spencer!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oof!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Argh!
The two fall to the ground with a thud!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Sorry! I suppose I should have adjusted my trajectory.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, or just gotten out of the way!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That's what I said!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Oh... Well, then... My bad.
$ALLISON climbs to her feet and continues on her way through the trees!
$ALLISON spins sharply to her right, just narrowly avoiding Spencer and his dog!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Ha! That was close!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Whoa! Nice move!
$ALLISON smiles as she continues on her way through the trees!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Um...
Unsure what to do, $ALLISON continues running...
$ALLISON barrels through the thicket of trees, dodging branches as she goes!
Suddenly, a high pitched barking sounds from the maze of greenery ahead!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: The poodle!
$ALLISON rushes toward the sound... But instead finds herself face to face with Spencer and his beagle, heading straight for her!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Come on, boy! We'll track that poodle if it's the last--

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `Whoa!` $ALLISON, look out!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Whoa![/i][/color] $ALLISON, look out!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Ah! I've got to...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'll try to circle around and corner it!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Good idea! Let's do it!
As Owen stays on the poodle's tail, $ALLISON breaks to the left and finds a different path into the woods!
Side-by-side, the two of them dash for the opening in the trees...
...But it's too narrow! They squish together, stuck for a moment, before stumbling to the ground!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oof!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Ah!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Maybe you should find another path. That way we can corner the dog, instead of tripping over each other!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Right!
They climb to their feet and split up, forking in two different directions.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Um...
Lost in thought, $ALLISON runs forward blindly!
$ALLISON and Owen bolt off toward the park just down the path from the animal shelter!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I don't see Paige's poodle anywhere!
The two of them scan their surroundings frantically.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: There!
He points a finger to a white, curly-haired dog in the distance!
As they rush in its direction side-by-side, it turns and darts onto a narrow path leading into a thick grove of trees!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: It's getting away! We should...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: See? Not everyone thinks you're dangerous.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Heh... No, I guess not.
Later, $ALLISON and the Troublemakers regroup outside the Centerscore Animal shelter.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Oates
nodes.text: Well, I have to admit... You kids did a great job today.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Oates
nodes.text: Hard to believe I actually expected you to lose one of my dogs! Can you imagine?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Nope! Just a regular day!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, your community just got `served.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, your community just got [color=#e23b3b][i]served.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mr. Oates
nodes.text: That it did! I see one of you is even going home with a new friend!
He turns to Owen, who places a brand new leash and collar on the scrappy old bulldog from earlier today.

nodes.speaker: Dog
nodes.text: Arf! Arf!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah. Figured us outcasts gotta stick together.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Oates
nodes.text: I'm happy to admit I was wrong about you folks. You're actually a good bunch! I'll be sure to let Ms. Lee know that.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I think we all learned a valuable lesson today.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: And what's that?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh... I don't `know.` I said I `think` we did.
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh... I don't [color=#e23b3b][i]know.[/i][/color] I said I [color=#e23b3b][i]think[/i][/color] we did.

nodes.text: Erik leaves on his way, followed by Kimi and Spencer. Owen hangs back to talk to $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Thanks for everything, $ALLISON. You kinda helped me out of a rut.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: It was no problem! It's the least I could do for a friend.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: We are... Friends, aren't we?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Of course. What else would you call us?
$ALLISON beams, smiling silently to herself.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I `did it!` One friendship `confirmed!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]did it![/i][/color] One friendship [color=#3b78e2][i]confirmed![/i][/color]

nodes.text: $ALLISON's celebration is cut short when Paige walks up to them...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hey, Owen.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So... You did me a solid today.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I guess that was pretty cool of you.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No problem.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Thought that poodle would act with some class. Didn't know she had so much bite to her.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Reminds me of someone I know.
Paige smiles and punches him playfully in the arm.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Jerk.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: See ya around.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah.
Owen and his newly adopted dog start down the sidewalk on their way home. An awkward silence settles over $ALLISON and Paige, the last two remaining.
$ALLISON begins to go her own way when Paige calls to her.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hey. I'll see you tomorrow, $ALLISON.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Right. Because... We're stuck in this together?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, yeah. Duh.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But I guess that's not such a bad thing.
Later, $ALLISON makes her way home as the sun lowers in the sky, still beaming from the day's activities.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Still all smiles, huh? You know, you keep grinning like that, your face is going to freeze that way.
$ALLISON turns around. Cameron calls to her as he leans against a car parked at the curb.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That's not accurate. Facial paralysis has nothing to do with prolonged expressions.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Oh, yeah? Then why can't you wipe that smile off?
$ALLISON tries to stop smiling as Cameron peers at her, teasingly. It only makes her blush.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I... Simply had a good day.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Right. Community service. What did you do today? Feed the hungry? Rescue a puppy?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: A fully grown dog, actually.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: No way. I was just kidding!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: It's true! We even found specimens that fit our personalities.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Very cool. Although I wouldn't have pegged you for a dog person. I'd say you're more like a...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: A dolphin.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I do circus tricks for tourists' amusement?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: No! I mean you're fun and, like, super-smart. You can't `not` like a dolphin.
nodes.text_bbcode: No! I mean you're fun and, like, super-smart. You can't [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] like a dolphin.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: That's a double-negative! Does that mean he thinks I'm likable?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I... Um... Thank you... For saying that.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: It's the truth. If you're as brainy as you seem, I might be asking for some help with bio class.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I'd be happy to assist you any time. In fact, I might stop by the library tonight and get some extra studying in...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Yeesh! Was that too flirty?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Well, I can't tonight. I still have that thing planned...
Just then, the front door of the house beside them opens...

nodes.speaker: Veronica
nodes.text: Ready to go, Cam! Hope you weren't waiting too--
Veronica's eyes lock on $ALLISON, and her gaze turns to ice...

nodes.speaker: Veronica
nodes.text: $ALLISON. What are you doing outside `my house?`
nodes.text_bbcode: $ALLISON. What are you doing outside [color=#3b78e2][i]my house?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Y.. Your house?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Yeah, I'm here to pick Veronica up.

nodes.speaker: Veronica
nodes.text: We're going to a coffee shop. Together. Just the two of us.

nodes.speaker: Veronica
nodes.text: Cameron's going to help me study. He's `so` smart. He's like a biology genius.
nodes.text_bbcode: Cameron's going to help me study. He's [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] smart. He's like a biology genius.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Biology? But he just said--

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I, uh... I do all right.
Cameron stammers, his cheeks just barely beginning to flush.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Anyway, we should get going. Maybe I'll see you tomorrow, $ALLISON?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Oh... Sure...

nodes.speaker: Veronica
nodes.text: Yeah. Later.
Veronica climbs into the passenger seat of Cameron's car, slamming the door behind her.
Cameron circles around to the driver's seat, flashing $ALLISON the slightest smile as he passes.
He gets into the car, and $ALLISON watches as he drives away...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Ugh... Boys are so confusing!
You have reached the end of `Season 1, Episode 2: Dog Days!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You have reached the end of [b]Season 1, Episode 2: Dog Days![/b]

Owen goes for an evening walk through the streets of Centerscore with his new friend by his side.
Owen bends down and scratches the newly-adopted hound. Hamlet nuzzles his scarred ear against Owen's leg, panting happily.
Leash in hand, Owen continues along the sidewalk, until he is stopped in his tracks by a familiar voice...
Looks like you still have a thing for hanging around with no-good animals.
A shady-looking guy close to Owen's age steps into the light of a streetlamp. With a smile, he strides over and gives Owen an overly-hard pat on the back.
Yeah... Haven't seen you since I left Pinecrest.
No worries, man. You know we always got a place for you. Once a 12th Street Kid, always a 12th Street Kid.
I thought I'd pay you a visit and check out this cushy 'Centerscore' place I've been hearing so much about.
How long you in town for?
For a while, buddy. Pinecrest was getting a little too boring.
...You mean you got in too much trouble and needed to lay low for a while.
That too. But it doesn't sound too different from what `you` did after you smashed that kid on the football field.
That... That was different. I needed to get away from that life.
Look, I don't blame you for turning tail and running. Sometimes you need to keep a low profile til the heat is off.
But that football incident is behind you now, man! You can relax! Come party with us!
The gang's all here. Me, Skinner, Big Jon, Beast... Everyone! We could have ourselves a good old-fashioned 12th Street Reunion. Wreak some havoc just like the old days!
This town'll never know what hit it!
Look... It's cool that you guys are here. And I can hang out, but... I don't do that stuff anymore. I'm trying to get my act together. Trying to make something of myself.
And I'm, what, a nobody? You too good for us now?
Well, be careful what you `do` say. I would think you'd want us on your side.
Weird. It almost sounds like you're threatening me.
I'm telling it like it is. If you're gonna punk out and turn your back on us, we're gonna treat you like a punk.
With a menacing glare, Dom steps forward... A little too close! Hamlet leaps forward with a sharp growl, snapping his teeth!
Looks like you're not his type.
Dom backs away, calling out mockingly.
Try to stay out of trouble, Dom.
The thing about trouble? You can try to stay out of it all you want...
Dom motions to Owen's bruised knuckles, knowingly.
Dom snickers as he disappears into the night. Hamlet whimpers and turns worried eyes up toward Owen. Owen gives him a pet.
I know, boy. I didn't like the sound of that either...

nodes.text: You are now playing as $ALLISON.
It's a cool, crisp morning as $ALLISON bounces cheerfully towards Twin Branches High for her second day of school.
She arrives on campus hours before the morning bell, hugging her thick stack of textbooks with a broad smile on her face.
Suddenly, a familiar voice calls to her from the front steps.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Hey, $ALLISON, right?
Cameron gives a casual wave and walks over to meet her.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Cameron! I mean, yes! That's correct. $ALLISON is my name.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Why are you here so early?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Oh, the swim team holds morning practices this time of year. What about you?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I like to study in the library before class starts to get a head start on the day's lessons.
Cameron's eyes shift to $ALLISON's towering stack of textbooks...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Whoa. Think you got enough books there?
$ALLISON eyes her collection of advanced texts, counting them...

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: I `thought` these would be sufficient! Do you think I need more?
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]thought[/i][/color] these would be sufficient! Do you think I need more?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Ha, funny.

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Well, I'm glad you think me... Um... Comical.
$ALLISON tries to contain her blushing as a grin pulls at the corners of her mouth.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: So what's got you all-smiles today? You skipping off to see the wizard?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Is this a pop culture reference, or is 'The Wizard' some student's colloquial nickname?
Cameron laughs.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I love it. Little $ALLISON's got jokes.
Cameron's smile is bright and contagious. $ALLISON finds herself giggling along with him, though she doesn't quite understand the joke.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: But seriously, did you have a good first day at Twin Branches?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Should I be blunt? Or act 'cool'?

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Well, I'd have to say my first day...

...But it's too far away!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Huff... Huff... Wait! Come back!
The poodle ignores $ALLISON, rushing out of the park and toward the city streets!
Catching her breath, $ALLISON can only watch as the animal wreaks havoc, nipping and barking at the innocent bystanders!
Finally, the dog runs into an upscale restaurant... And comes out again followed by a chorus of angry, panicked shrieks and a coil of linked sausages in her mouth!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Oates
nodes.text: No! What happened?
The shelter supervisor comes running out from the park, his horrified eyes wide as he watches the escaped dog flee!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: It... It was an accident, sir!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Oates
nodes.text: Oh, I'll `tell` you what the accident was. It was ever trusting a task to hooligans like `you!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, I'll [color=#e23b3b][i]tell[/i][/color] you what the accident was. It was ever trusting a task to hooligans like [color=#e23b3b][i]you![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Mr. Oates
nodes.text: You'd better believe your supervisors will hear every word of what happened today!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: Oh no!
Later, the entire Troublemakers crew gathers in Ms. Lee's office.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: I can't believe this... Do you know how much trouble that one poodle caused before Animal Control could wrangle her?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: How many people she scared? How many sausages she stole? How many lawns she 'did her business' on?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Enough business-doo-doing for the school board to disband the Troublemakers program.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: In lieu of community service, all of you are to report to detention `every day` for the rest of this quarter.
nodes.text_bbcode: In lieu of community service, all of you are to report to detention [color=#3b78e2][i]every day[/i][/color] for the rest of this quarter.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `What?!` But that's so unfair!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]What?![/i][/color] But that's so unfair!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, what about my social life?!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: ...And my football practice?!

nodes.speaker: Allison
nodes.text: ...And my friends?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: ...My studies?

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Well, these are all very valid concerns about very important things that you have ruined by setting a poodle free.

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: All of you are dismissed.
The six students groan and begin to leave...

nodes.speaker: Ms. Lee
nodes.text: Not you, Owen. The principal has seen your record and asked to see you specifically, considering your... `History` as a menace.
nodes.text_bbcode: Not you, Owen. The principal has seen your record and asked to see you specifically, considering your... [color=#3b78e2][i]History[/i][/color] as a menace.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Right... Of course.
As $ALLISON watches Owen and Paige exchange the briefest expressions of sadness, she knows in her heart...
...She has failed.

pov_note: Multi-POV episode. `pov` on a segment is the playable character in control on entry; a node's `set_pov` switches the current POV mid-stream (these are the game's 'You are now playing as X' cards). A dialogue node's `side` is 'left' when the speaker is the current POV (the game shows the current main on the left) and 'right' otherwise. POV is propagated in execution order from `entry`; only main_characters can hold it.
